title: GDG on Campus All Around the World! : Jordan x Türkiye Edition
summary: Join us for a unique online workshop, a collaborative event bridging GDG on Campus Bolu Abant Izzet Baysal University an...
descriptionHtml:
Join us for a unique online workshop, a collaborative event bridging GDG on Campus Bolu Abant Izzet Baysal University and GDG on Campus Al-Balqa' Applied University! Delve into "GDG on Campus All Around the World! : Jordan x Türkiye Edition," where we'll explore the nuances of machine learning models.

Ever wondered why a machine learning model with 95% accuracy can completely fail in the real world? In this interactive session, we’ll break down the gap between theory and reality in ML.

Discover issues like Overfitting, Concept Drift, and learn why metrics like Precision and Recall might sometimes mislead. Walk away with practical insights to build models that excel outside the lab, not just on paper. Unlock the secrets to understanding the real-world application of AI models.

Don't miss out! Be part of an engaging AI exploration—secure your spot today and take your first step in mastering real-world AI deployment.

descriptionHtml:

title: CampusFest
summary: CampusFest yapay zeka, veri bilimi, bulut teknolojileri ve oyun geliştirme gibi alanlarda uzman konuşmacıları, atölyeleri ve sürpriz hediyeleriyle gençleri bir araya getiren ilham dolu, ücretsiz ve sertifikalı bir kariyer etkinliğidir.
descriptionHtml:
🎓 CampusFest 2025

Gençlik enerjisiyle bilginin kesiştiği noktada yer alan CampusFest, bu yıl üniversite öğrencilerini kariyerlerine yön verecek dopdolu bir programla karşılıyor. Etkinlik, farklı alanlarda uzmanlaşmış konuşmacılar, yaratıcı atölyeler, networking fırsatları ve çekilişlerle dağıtılacak sürpriz hediyeler ile katılımcılara unutulmaz bir deneyim sunmayı hedeflemektedir.

🛠️ Atölyeler (Gamelab İş Birliğiyle)

CampusFest kapsamında, öğrenmenin ötesine geçerek katılımcılara uygulamalı deneyimler sunulmaktadır.

• Yapay Zeka Destekli Veri Analizi Atölyesi

Veri üzerinde yapay zekanın gücünü keşfetmek isteyen katılımcılar için özel olarak tasarlanmıştır.

• C++ ile Oyun Programlama Atölyesi

C++ diliyle oyun geliştirmenin temellerine giriş yapmak isteyenler için teknik bir atölye sunulmaktadır.

🎁 Sürpriz Hediyeler ve Çekilişler

Etkinlik boyunca yapılacak çekilişler ile birçok sürpriz hediye katılımcılara ulaştırılacaktır. Katılın, öğrenin ve kazanma şansını yakalayın.

🧾 Katılım Sertifikası

Tüm katılımcılara, Digicertify sponsorluğunda dijital katılım sertifikası verilecektir.

🤝 Sponsorluklarımız

Etkinlik, güçlü sponsor ağı ile daha etkili ve zengin içerikli bir yapıya kavuşmuştur.

• Çekiliş Sponsorları: Arcode Digital, Pragma, Espresso Lab, Miull, Duman Coffee, At Kafası

• Sertifika Sponsoru: Digicertify

• Medya Sponsoru: Etkin Kampüs

• Ürün Sponsorları: Mikel Coffee Company, Pingpong

🎟️ Katılım Bilgisi

CampusFest, tüm üniversite öğrencilerine açık ve ücretsizdir.

title: ZİRVE'25
summary: From May 6–8, 2025, we proudly took part as a stakeholder in the summits organized by the European Relations Community, covering business, digital media, and diplomacy. As GDG on Campus AIBU, we engaged in networking and shared our vision with participants.
descriptionHtml:
🎓 **Three Inspiring Summit Days at Bolu Abant İzzet Baysal University!**

On May 6–8, 2025, a series of summits hosted by Bolu Abant İzzet Baysal University and organized by the European Relations Community brought together leading names from the fields of business, digital media, and diplomacy.

📅 **May 6 – Business Summit**

📅 **May 7 – Digital Media Summit**

📅 **May 8 – Diplomacy Summit**

Throughout this visionary three-day event, over 20 expert speakers from across Türkiye shared their insights and experiences across more than 15 sessions. Each day offered thematic panels, current topics, career tips, and in-depth discussions, providing an inspiring experience for all participants.

🎁 Raffles & surprise gifts

🤝 Networking opportunities

🎯 Interaction areas with communities, startups, and brands

📄 Participation certificates

As **Google Developer Groups on Campus AIBU (gdgdoncampusibu)**, we were honored to take part in this meaningful event as a stakeholder community. It was a valuable opportunity to showcase our vision in technology, innovation, and digital transformation, while building strong connections with participants from various disciplines.

title: GDGonCampusAIBU: Back on Campus! 🚀
summary: 🚀 On March 21, 2025, we organized a booth event as the GDG on Campus team! 🌟 We introduced our community, connected with our members, and shared details about the hackathons, coding workshops, and networking events we planned. 💬 By gathering feedback, we strengthened our community spirit and shaped future projects! 🎯
descriptionHtml:
As the GDG on Campus team, we organized an exciting booth event! 🌟 Our goal was to introduce our community more closely and establish effective communication with our members to learn about the events they wish to participate in this term. 💬

At the booth, we shared our community’s mission, vision, and goals while providing detailed information about the events we planned, including hackathons, coding workshops, networking sessions, and motivation activities. 🎯

We also listened to the ideas that caught our members’ interest and aimed to shape our future projects based on their feedback. With high participation, this event strengthened our community spirit and marked the first step toward an amazing new term! 🎉

title: AI-BU Gelecegi Kodlayan Kadınlar
summary: We held our event AI-BU: Women Coding the Future on March 8, International Women’s Day. Focused on the role of women in the AI sector and AI ethics, the event featured Ecem Şafak as our speaker. We conducted interactive tests on AI ethics, and participants received certificates at the end. 💖
descriptionHtml: We organized the **AI-BU: Women Coding the Future** event on March 8, International Women’s Day, to strengthen the role of women in the AI sector and raise awareness about AI ethics. Our speaker, Ecem Şafak, covered key topics such as AI ethics, bias and discrimination, privacy, transparency, and fair usage. During the interactive session, participants worked on specially designed scenarios to test and discuss AI ethical principles. We also explored case studies to understand the practical dimensions of AI ethics. At the end of the event, we awarded certificates to all participants. Through this valuable event, we aimed to promote an ethical perspective in AI and emphasize the importance of women in the field. 💖

title: AI-BU Day 3-4
summary:
Are you ready to continue exploring the world of AI? In the second week of AI BU, we will dive into **Deep Learning and Neural Networks** with Çağan Kiper's valuable insights.  
📅 March 1, 2025 - Saturday
⏰ 13:00 - 16:00 
📍 Microsoft Teams  
Participants who attend at least 3 out of 5 sessions will receive a certificate, and 5 selected individuals will get an exclusive AI training.
descriptionHtml: In the second week of AI BU, we will explore Deep Learning and Neural Networks with Çağan Kiper. This session covers the fundamentals of deep learning, popular tools, and an image classification application using the MNIST dataset. Join us on March 1, 2025, from 13:00 to 16:00 on Microsoft Teams to enhance your AI skills. Participants attending 3 out of 5 sessions will receive a certificate, and 5 selected individuals will get exclusive AI training.

title: AI-BU Day 2
summary: On the 2nd day of our AI-BU event, AI expert Caner Şekercioğlu provided an interactive Silicon Valley interview experience. Participants tested both their technical and personal skills in a real interview atmosphere. At the end of the session, two participants were offered internship opportunities.
descriptionHtml: On the 2nd day of our AI-BU event, we hosted AI expert Caner Şekercioğlu. In this session, he provided participants with a Silicon Valley interview experience. Caner Şekercioğlu created a real interview atmosphere, assessing participants with both technical and personal questions. During the interview process, he gave feedback, highlighting participants' strengths and areas for improvement. At the end of the session, the two most successful participants were offered internship opportunities. This interactive experience helped participants enhance their interview skills and take a significant step forward in their careers.

title: AI-BU Day 1
summary: At the AI-BU event, we hosted AI expert Caner Şekercioğlu. In the first session, he covered What is Artificial Intelligence?, History of AI, Application Areas, Types of Machine Learning, and Data Processing & Visualization. He provided in-depth insights, from the fundamentals of AI to its impact on various industries.
descriptionHtml:
At the AI-BU event, we hosted AI expert Caner Şekercioğlu and conducted a comprehensive training on artificial intelligence. In the first session, he answered the question What is Artificial Intelligence?, explaining the fundamental concepts and the working principles of the technology. He then delved into the History of AI, sharing the development process, key milestones, and significant global advancements in AI.

Throughout the training, he elaborated on how AI is used in various sectors such as healthcare, finance, automotive, and security. He also explained the differences between supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning under the umbrella of Types of Machine Learning. Regarding Data Processing and Visualization, he discussed the importance of data for AI, the analysis processes, and its role in decision-making mechanisms.

title: LinkedIn Day
summary: Arif Tumiçin KIZILASLAN shared his valuable experiences on professional networking strategies and building an effective profile. Participants learned how to stand out on LinkedIn.
descriptionHtml:
Arif Tumiçin KIZILASLAN shared his extensive experience in professional networking strategies and creating an impactful profile. Throughout the training, participants had the opportunity to learn the intricacies of building a professional presence on LinkedIn and standing out on the platform.

Mr. Kızılaslan highlighted the key elements necessary for creating a strong LinkedIn profile. He discussed the importance of standout sections, the strategic use of relevant keywords, and how profiles supported by effective visuals can leave a positive impression on employers and professional networks. Additionally, he provided practical tips on personal branding, crafting an engaging summary, and effectively presenting professional experiences.

title: Git & GitHub Day
summary: Git & GitHub Training: İsmail Hakkı Parlak provided us with a comprehensive overview of GitHub, one of the indispensable tools in the software world. Participants learned how to manage their projects more efficiently.
descriptionHtml: The Git & GitHub Training, led by İsmail Hakkı Parlak, offered a comprehensive and interactive experience for participants eager to learn the key strategies for managing projects more efficiently in the software world. İsmail Hakkı Parlak emphasized the importance of Git and GitHub in the software development process and shared detailed insights on how to effectively use these tools.
